newsitem.title: EGYPT: PLO's Kaddoumi says no Israel-PLO agreement soon.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Kaddoumi says no Israel-PLO agreement soon.

text.p: A senior Palestinian official said on Wednesday he did not expect any agreement soon with Israel but hoped U.S. President Bill Clinton would press Israel to honour existing agreements.
The PLO and Israel are reported far apart in talks on implementing the deal signed by Israel's previous government on an Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron.

"I do not expect an agreement between the Palestinians and Israelis will be signed soon," the head of the PLO political department, Farouk Kaddoumi, told reporters after meeting Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa.
Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy is coming to Cairo on Thursday for talks with Egyptian officials.
"We hope the American sponsor will exert required efforts to press Israel, so that it might abide by the (existing) agreements," he said.
Kaddoumi said he was touring the region to prepare "a joint meeting between the frontline states and the Arab League for consultation and coordination about the coming stage."
